To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have studied the J/psi production as a function of transverse momentum and of rapidity in the range 0.9 y 2.5 and 2.3 y 4 in pp collisions at 7 TeV, using the ALICE detector.

The J/psi production cross section at central rapidity is 10.7 +/- 1.0(stat.) +/- 1.6(syst.) +/- 1 (syst. pol.) microb, and that at forward rapidity it is 6.3 +/- 0.25(stat.) +/- 0.76(syst.) +/-1.96(syst. pol.)microb.
the J/psi production cross sections in pp collisions at the LHC are larger by a factor of 2-3 than the corresponding cross sections in the Tevatron pp collisions.
